Rashi on Nedarim 33a:10:1.english: Who taught - that driving away [harm] is permitted.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:1:1.hebrew: והא מן מאכל עצמו נדר - ואמאי אסור להשאילו נפה, והני לאו מאכל נינהו:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:1:1.english: But didn't he vow from food itself - And why is it forbidden to lend him a sieve, [when] these are not food?

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:1:2.english: Benefit from your food [is] upon me - [it] shall be forbidden.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:2:1.hebrew: ואימא - מאי הנאת מאכלך? שלא ילעוס חיטין שלו ויתן על גבי מכתו, והיינו נמי הנאת מאכלך, ואכתי אמאי לא ישאילנו נפה וכברה:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:2:1.english: And say - What is [meant by] "benefit of your food"? That he may not chew his wheat [kernels] and place [them] upon his wound, and that too is "benefit of your food"; yet still, why may he not lend him a fine sieve or a coarse sieve?

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:2:2.hebrew: המביאה לידי מאכלך עלי - ונפה וכברה מביא מאכלו למאכל, ולהכי לא ישאילנו לו:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:2:2.english: [Benefit] that leads to your food [is forbidden] to me - And a fine sieve and a coarse sieve bring his food to [being] food, and therefore he may not lend it to him.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:3:1.hebrew: אפי' שק וכו' ואפי' צנא בעלמא - של מדיר, אסור למודר ליתן בה פירות, דהנאה המביאה לידי מאכל הוא, ואסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:3:1.english: Even a sack, etc., and even merely a basket - [Belonging] to the one who imposed the vow: it is forbidden for the one bound by the vow to put produce in it, for it is a benefit that leads to food, and [it is] forbidden.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:3:2.english: A horse upon which to ride - to go to the banquet hall.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:3:3.hebrew: או טבעת ליראות בה - בבית המשתה, כדי שינהגו בו כבוד, והיינו הנאה:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:3:3.english: Or a ring with which to be seen - [At] a banquet, so that they will treat him with honor, and that is [the] benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:3:4.english: Traversing and walking on his land - [That is,] he walks through his land to the house of the feast and shortens his way.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:3:5.english: What is [the ruling] - Is it [considered] benefit that leads to food in all these [cases] or not?

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:4:1.hebrew: צריכא למימר - דשרי? הא ליכא הנאה כלל:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:4:1.english: [Does it] need to be said - that it is permitted? Behold, there is no benefit at all.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:4:2.english: And it teaches: he may lend [to] him - And learn from it that it is permitted.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:5:1.hebrew: לא לעולם - אפי' שלא ליראות בה, ובדין הוא דלא היה צריך למיתני משאילו:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:5:1.english: No, actually - Even [where it is] not to be seen with it, and by rights [the Mishnah] would not have needed to teach "he may lend him."

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:5:2.english: Rather, since, etc. - And from this, one cannot infer [an answer to Rav Pappa's dilemma].

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:6:1.hebrew: מקום שמשכירין - שנוהגין להשאיל כל אלו הדברים על ידי שכירות, אסור למדיר להשאילו. דכיון שנוהגים להשכיר, מיחזי כהנאה המביאה לידי מאכל, ואסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:6:1.english: A place where one rents - [Where] they are accustomed to lend all these items for a rental fee, it is forbidden for the one who imposed the vow to lend [it] to him. For since they are accustomed to rent [them out], it appears like a benefit that leads to food, and it is forbidden.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:7:1.hebrew: מכלל דרישא - דקתני "לא ישאילנו נפה וכברה", הוי אע"פ שאין משכירין; כלומר, שאין נוהגין להשאיל בשכירות. אע"ג דלא הוי הנאה גמורה — דכיון שאין משכירין, מאי קא מהני ליה? אם זה לא ישאילנו, שכנו אחר משאילו בחנם, שהרי מקום שאין משכירין הוא:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:7:1.english: By inference, [one may conclude] that the first clause - Which teaches, "He may not lend him a sieve or a strainer," [meaning] it is [forbidden] even if [they are in a place where] one does not rent [them] — that is to say, where it is not customary to lend for a rental fee — even though it is not a full benefit, for since one does not rent [them], what benefit does he derive from him? If this one will not lend it to him, another neighbor of his will lend it to him for free, since it is a place where one does not rent [them].

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:7:2.english: Who taught [this] - That even so, it is prohibited.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:7:3.hebrew: ר' אליעזר היא - אבל סיפא, דקתני מקום שמשכירין אסור, דברי הכל היא, דהנאה גמורה היא:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:7:3.english: It is Rabbi Eliezer - However, the latter clause, which teaches [that in] a place where they rent [them] it is prohibited, is [the opinion of] all, since it is a complete benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:8:1.hebrew: שוקל לו את שקלו - המדיר יכול ליתן בשבילו מחצית השקל שנותנין לתרומת הלשכה, ויכול לפרוע חובו, ואין מהנה לו כלום. מדקתני פורע חובו, אלמא לא מהני ליה מנכסיו, דהא לא יהיב ליה בידים ממש:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:8:1.english: He may pay his shekel for him - The one who imposed the vow may give on his behalf the half-shekel that is given for the appropriation of the [Temple] chamber, and he may repay his debt, and he does not benefit him at all. Since [the Mishnah] teaches "he repays his debt," it is evident that he does not benefit him from his property, for he does not actually give [it] to him directly into [his] hands.

Rashi on Nedarim 33a:9:1.hebrew: אלמא אברוחי ארי בעלמא הוא - שמבריח חובו מעליו, ושרי:
Rashi on Nedarim 33a:9:1.english: Apparently, it is merely driving away a lion - For he drives away his debt from him, and [it is] permitted.

Rashi on Nedarim 33b:6:1.english: The benefit shall fall to consecrated property - [This is] explained in the Gemara.

Tosafot on Nedarim 33a:2:1.hebrew: אימא שלא ילעוס חיטין - משום הנאת מאכל לעיסתך, ואפי' מחטין של מדיר עצמו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 33a:2:1.english: Say that he may not chew wheat - [This is] because of the benefit of food [from] chewing your [wheat], and even from the wheat of the madir [the one from whom benefit is forbidden] himself.

Tosafot on Nedarim 33a:3:1.hebrew: וטבעת להראות בו - כאדם עשיר בבית המשתה, וע"י כך יתנו לו מנה יפה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 33a:3:1.english: Or a ring to be seen with it - [appearing] like a wealthy person at a banquet, and through this they will give him a fine portion.

Tosafot on Nedarim 33a:7:1.hebrew: מאן תנא אמר רבא ר"א היא - וא"ת: תנן חדא זימנא ברישא ר"א? וי"ל, דמכח הך דהכא מדקדק לעיל דאתי כר"א, דאי לאו האי הוה מוקמינן ליה בחצר ודכ"ע; ולכך מדקדק הכא מסיפא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 33a:7:1.english: "Who [is the tanna who] taught [this]? Rava said: It is Rabbi Eliezer" - And if you ask: We already learned once in the first clause [that the Mishnah follows] Rabbi Eliezer? One can answer that it is on the basis of this [clause] here that [the Gemara] inferred earlier that [the first clause] follows Rabbi Eliezer; for if not for this [clause], we would have established [the first clause] as referring to a courtyard, and [it would thus follow] everyone's [opinion]. Therefore, [the Gemara] makes its inference here from the latter clause.
